columns.name: Basic Information
columns.valueCondition:
const assessmentData = this.assessmentBasicInformation || {}; let htmlString = `
Assessment Title: ${assessmentData.assessmenttitle || "N/A"}
Assessment Type: ${ assessmentData.assessmenttype ? ( { "APTITUDE": "Aptitude", "TECHINICAL": "Technical", "PERSONALITY": "Personality", "CODING": "Coding", "GROUP_DISCUSSION": "Group Discussion", "INTERVIEW": "Interview" }[assessmentData.assessmenttype] || assessmentData.assessmenttype ) : "N/A" }
Instructions (Optional): ${assessmentData.instructions || "N/A"}
`; return htmlString;

const configData = this.assessmentConfiguration || {}; let htmlString = `
Duration: ${configData.duration || "N/A"} mins
Total Questions: ${configData.totalquestions || "N/A"}
Maximum Score: ${configData.maximumscore || "N/A"}
Passing Score: ${configData.passingscore || "N/A"}
`; return htmlString;
columns.name: Assessment Configuration
Schedule
columns.valueCondition:
const scheduleData = this.assessmentSchedule || {}; function formatDate(dateStr) { if (!dateStr) return "N/A"; const date = new Date(dateStr); return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" }); } function formatTime(timeStr) { if (!timeStr) return "N/A"; const [hour, minute] = timeStr.split(":"); const date = new Date(); date.setHours(hour, minute); return date.toLocaleTimeString("en-GB", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }); } let htmlString = `
Date: ${formatDate(scheduleData.startdate)} - ${formatDate(scheduleData.enddate)}
Time: ${formatTime(scheduleData.starttime)} - ${formatTime(scheduleData.endtime)}
`; return htmlString;

columns.name: Association
columns.valueCondition:
const associationData = this.assessmentAssociation || {}; const associateOptions = { "NO_ASSOCIATION_STANDALONE": "No Association (Standalone)", "PLACEMENT_DRIVE": "Placement Drive", "TRAINING_PROGRAM": "Training Program" }; let htmlString = `
Associate With: ${associateOptions[associationData.associatewith] || "N/A"}
`; return htmlString;
